author: Sevastianov, 1802
summary: 툰드라의 호수나 석호 부근에서 번식하는 기러기로, 알래스카 서부와 시베리아 북동부 해안에 분포한다. 보통 알을 4~6개 낳아 대략 24~27일 동안 품는다. 털갈이 때 번식하지 않는 개체들은 알래스카의 세인트로렌스섬에 크게 모이거나 시베리아 추코스키 반도 북부로 모이고, 번식 집단은 번식지 가까이에서 털갈이를 한다.

art.subject: Emperor Goose (Anser canagicus), adult: head and hindneck white, the face often stained rusty-orange; chin, throat and foreneck black; body bluish slate-grey, each feather of the back, scapulars, breast and flanks with a black subterminal band and a narrow white tip, giving a bold scaly pattern; flight feathers darker grey; tail white. Bill short, pale pink; dark eye; legs and feet bright orange.
art.scene: coastal tundra lagoon shore with a shallow lake; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view standing: white head and hindneck, black chin, throat and foreneck, short thick neck, bluish dark grey body with bold black-and-white scaling on the back and flanks, white tail, pink bill, orange legs
adult, head detail: white head often with rusty staining on the face, black chin and throat continuing down the foreneck, short thick neck, short pink bill
art.build: Medium-sized, compact goose, about 77 cm in the book, slightly smaller and plumper than Greater White-fronted Goose, with a short, thick neck and a small head. Bill small and short, much shorter than the head, pink. Legs short, orange. At rest the wingtips reach about the tail tip and the white tail shows beneath them. In flight uniformly dark blue-grey wings, white tail and white head.
avoid: Do not paint a white body or black wingtips; that is Snow Goose (Anser caerulescens).
Do not paint a grey-brown head and neck like other grey geese; the head and hindneck are white.
Do not give it a long neck; it is short and thick.
Do not paint black legs; they are orange.
